Stay Paused fixtures

Middle-click or Cmd-click these to open them in background tabs, then switch to each tab. Nothing should play until you interact with the page.

  • Autoplay attribute
  • JS play() on load
  • new Audio() not in the DOM
  • Muted autoplay
  • Muted autoplay, then unmuted by script
  • Same-origin and cross-origin iframes
  • Borrowed play() from an about:blank iframe
